info.title: The Tiffin Club API
info.description:
Public store API + Customer (Clerk) API + Admin API, generated from docs/api.md and docs/admin-api.md. Import into Apidog via **Settings → Import Data → OpenAPI/Swagger**.

- Every response uses the envelope `{ success, message, data }` (errors add `errors: { field: [...] }`).
- All money amounts are integer **cents** (`1600` = $16.00). All times are `Pacific/Auckland`; timestamps are ISO-8601, menu/ordering times are `HH:mm`.
- Non-production only: send `X-Simulated-Time: <ISO-8601>` to fake "now" (echoed in `X-App-Time-Now`); ignored in production.
- Auth: Clerk JWT bearer for customer endpoints; Sanctum token bearer for admin endpoints (staff email allowlist).

clerkBearer.description: Clerk JWT. Verified against Clerk's JWKS (issuer, `azp` origin allow-list, expiry); must carry `email_verified: true`. The verified email maps to the `customers` row. Missing/invalid → 401. Requires `CLERK_ISSUER` and `CLERK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `.env`.

adminBearer.description: Sanctum personal access token from `POST /admin/login`. Access limited to the staff email allowlist (`ADMIN_EMAILS`). 401 without token, 403 off-allowlist.

SimulatedTime.name: X-Simulated-Time
SimulatedTime.description: QA/staging only: server treats this instant as "now" for every time-based rule. Unparseable → 400. Ignored when `APP_ENV=production`.

OrderStatus.description: Orders are returned as `confirmed` immediately on placement (auto-confirm; manual staff confirmation to come).

manage_token.description: 64 hex chars. Sole handle to view/edit/cancel. Only returned on placement.

customer.description: Live customer details at read time (not a placement snapshot); absent if the relation isn't eager-loaded.

expires_at.description: Manage token lifetime ends here — 23:59:59 on the order day.

get.description: Public store settings, read-only. `delivery_suburbs` feeds order placement validation (`suburb` must be in this list for delivery). `pickup_map_url` is nullable.

pickup_map_url.description: Maps deep link for the pickup address.

get.description: Today's published menu plus the ordering window. Clients never compute open/closed themselves — use `data.ordering.state`: `open` | `opening_later` | `closing_soon` | `closed`.

post.description:
Place a guest order for today's menu → **201**. `manage_token` (64 hex) is only returned here — store it.

Rules: `name` required; at least one of `email`/`phone` (both optional individually); `suburb` required for delivery and must be in `delivery_suburbs`; `items.*.id` must exist on today's menu, `quantity` 1–20.

Side effects: resolves/updates the customer (find-or-create by email, then phone; email match wins), fires `OrderPlaced` after commit, queues a confirmation email when the customer has an email. Initial status `confirmed` (auto-confirm).

Authenticated placement: with a Bearer token present, payload `email` (when given) must match the JWT email → else 422; invalid-but-present token → 401.

email.description: Required together with phone if phone absent. Lowercased.

post.description: Knowledge-based lookup: manage token + the email or phone used at checkout — matched against the customer's **current** email/phone (both live values). Every failure (unknown token, expired token, wrong contact) answers identically **404** — nothing leaks.

404.description: Unknown token, expired token, or wrong contact — identical response for all three.

get.description: View an order by manage token.

410.description: Token expired (past 23:59:59 on the order day).

patch.description:
Edit an order before cutoff. All fields `sometimes`; applied fields are `fulfilment`, `delivery_notes`, `items`. Item ids validated against the order's own menu. Changing `fulfilment` to `delivery` does **not** re-validate a suburb — validate client-side against `GET /settings`.

Known gap: the request still *accepts* `name`, `address`, `suburb` (validated then silently ignored — these live on the customer). Email/phone are rejected.

id.description: Must exist on the order's menu.

422.description: Validation failed / off-menu items / after cutoff (`ordering`).

delete.description: Cancel an order before cutoff → **200** with the order object (`status: "cancelled"`). After cutoff only staff may cancel (not exposed via this API).

get.description: The signed-in customer. **Creates** the row from the JWT name + email on first request.

patch.description: Update contact/delivery details. All fields optional. `suburb` must be in the delivery list; `phone` unique.

get.description: Every order on the email-matched customer row — guest history included — newest first. No row yet → `data: []` (never creates one).

post.description: Email + password → `{ data: { token: "1|...", user: { name, email } } }`. Account must be on the staff email allowlist (`ADMIN_EMAILS`). Rate limited 10/min → 429.

get.description: Paginated (`data: { resource, links, meta }`). Includes customer + payments (with `paid` sum). Filters: `status`, `fulfilment`, `customer_id`, `menu_id`. Sorts: `placed_at`, `total` (`-` prefix = descending). Default `-placed_at`.

403.description: Account not on the staff allowlist.

get.description: Single order; includes items, payments, customer.

patch.description: Status only — order contents are immutable. 422 if cancelling an order with a recorded paid sum > 0 (payments are immutable; ADR 0002). Writes an audit entry (`status_changed`, actor `staff`).

422.description: Invalid status, or cancelling an order with a recorded paid sum > 0.

post.description: Records a manual cash payment. `amount` in **cents**. 422 if the amount exceeds the order's outstanding balance. Payments are immutable — no edit/refund/delete/fail endpoints (ADR 0002).

422.description: Amount exceeds the order's outstanding balance.

get.description: Single customer; includes orders (with payments), newest first.

patch.description: Any of `name`, `email`, `phone`, `address`, `suburb`. Email lowercased, phone normalized to digits. No create/delete/blocking.

get.description: Paginated. Filter: `menu_date`. Sort: `menu_date`. Default `-menu_date`. Includes items.

delete.description: Deletes the menu and its items.

409.description: Conflict — an order references the menu.

patch.description: Same fields as create, all optional.

put.description: Partial update of any known key. Unknown keys are rejected.
